method: Built-in image_gen tool; one edit call per tier
editTargets: Each original grayscale crest was supplied as its own edit target. Colors change; the shield, shuttlecock, and tier ornament remain recognizable.

delivery.processing: Aspect-preserving downscale and WebP encoding in Chromium canvas; no visual edits.

assets.color: rich warm copper and burnt orange
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: colored badminton rank crest for a compact mobile UI. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing BRONZE tier crest. Change only its color/material finish. Preserve its exact silhouette, centered front view, shield geometry, shuttlecock shape, feather ornaments, stars, crown if any, lighting, clean bevels, and transparent edge. Recolor the shield rim and ALL outer metal ornaments in rich warm copper and burnt orange, with a dominant midtone near #B86A37. Use clearly colored metal and enamel surfaces over substantial areas so this rank is immediately identifiable even at 40 pixels, rather than tiny color accents. Tint the dark inner shield toward a deep darker version of that hue. Keep the central shuttlecock ivory white and bright polished silver for legibility. This is one of six clearly different tier hues. The crest must clearly read as the requested hue, not grayscale. Preserve polished dimensional metal highlights and original ornament. Output exactly ONE complete crest, centered in a square frame at the same relative scale with a small clear margin. Genuinely transparent background; retain alpha, no background shadow, no plate, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no new symbols. Do not redesign the crest or add ornament.
